scripts.build: command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 && forge build || echo '[Contracts] Foundry not installed, skipping smart contract build'
scripts.deploy:anvil: PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" forge script script/DeployLevera.s.sol:DeployLevera --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast && tsx scripts/record_deployment.ts
